431:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Don't hold out on me. I've already heard about your misdeeds.」

431:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... always make a point of being completely sincere with you, $$トライア$$...」

431:t_1:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the pointless flattery and get on with it.」

431:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「We don't need any silly sentiment between us. All I want is results.」

431:t_1:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To think $$ＡＧ$$ had called in Dr. $$トライア$$...」

431:t_1:11.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It seems he knew what was here even before we captured this base.」

431:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's no point grilling him now. He'll just string together plausible excuses anyway.」

431:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... I can hardly believe yesterday's confession was the whole story.」

431:t_1:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this system concerns you too...」

431:t_1:17.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I was the leader of the $$ギアス嚮団$$, after all. ...Though I was little more than a figurehead.」

431:t_1:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「With Miss $$シビル$$ and $$ＡＧ$$'s help, I've worked out roughly what this facility does.」

431:t_1:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems coming here really does stir the dormant $$プロトデビルン$$ blood in her.」

431:t_1:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「You were right, Captain $$ジェフリー$$. This system drains $$スピリチア$$... what we call the power of life.」

431:t_1:31.en:
$$トライア$$
「If we force their terminology into our language, I suppose we'd call it a $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

431:t_1:32.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I see... So its purpose is to draw out $$オリジン・ロー$$... $$次元力$$, using that power.」

431:t_1:33.en:
$$トライア$$
「Correct. $$サイデリアル$$ extracts $$次元力$$ along Earth's energy veins, gathers it through $$レイライン$$s...」

431:t_1:34.en:
$$トライア$$
「And, we believe, controls it with the power of life drained from the people of Earth.」

431:t_1:35.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I thought $$スフィア$$s were used to control $$次元力$$...」

431:t_1:36.en:
$$トライア$$
「Of course they'll use $$スフィア$$s too. But I think the $$スフィア$$s have another purpose of their own.」

431:t_1:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「They probably prepared this as a way to use $$次元力$$ reliably for strategic purposes when that time comes.」

431:t_1:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then the reason those patients with $$血塗られた眼$$ end up with their minds in a dead state is...」

431:t_1:39.en:
$$トライア$$
「Mind, emotion, consciousness... They lose those things because their power of life has been drained.」

431:t_1:44.en:
$$トライア$$
「People whose $$スピリチア$$ was absorbed by $$プロトデビルン$$s could reactivate the $$スピリチア$$ inside them through $$熱気バサラ$$'s song...」

431:t_1:45.en:
$$トライア$$
「The patients with $$血塗られた眼$$ could probably regain their power of life through a similar process.」

431:t_1:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「...That's not all there is to it. Those eyes aren't caused solely by the loss of the power of life...」

431:t_1:48.en:
$$トライア$$
「They're proof that fear has taken over their minds... You could say they're trauma given physical form.」

431:t_1:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Unless we remove the source of that fear, we can't treat the underlying cause...」

431:t_1:50.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is that also why $n's $$血塗られた眼$$ haven't healed completely?」

431:t_1:51.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ showed me the data on $F.」

431:t_1:52.en:
$$トライア$$
「Judging by that boy's reactions and $$サイデリアル$$'s strategy, we should assume the main $$霊子吸収システム$$ is in $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

431:t_1:53.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We should regard this as a prototype built before the invasion of the $$蒼の地球$$.」

431:t_1:54.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And the people abducted from all over are gathered in $$ラース・バビロン$$, where their power of life is absorbed.」

431:t_1:55.en:
$$トライア$$
「Humans aren't the only ones who possess the power of life, though...」

431:t_1:57.en:
$$トライア$$
「As long as matter exists as matter, a force allowing it to exist is at work within it.」

431:t_1:58.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「In other words, it possesses the power of life...」

431:t_1:59.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Does that mean... even objects have souls!?」

431:t_1:60.en:
$$トライア$$
「Is that hard to believe?」

431:t_1:62.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I thought so. I understand the theory myself, but I still can't grasp it intuitively.」

431:t_1:64.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll leave that for later. Right now, we need to think about stopping $$サイデリアル$$'s $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

431:t_1:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To do that, let's capture $$セントラル・ベース$$ and free the $$翠の地球$$ as soon as possible.」

431:t_1:68.en:
$$トライア$$
「...This is the first time we've properly met face to face, $n.」

431:t_1:70.en:
$$トライア$$
「You really do resemble Dr. $$メグミ$$. Maybe it's the hair...」

431:t_1:72.en:
$$トライア$$
「You can't keep running away, $n.」

431:t_1:74.en:
$$トライア$$
「She was a big part of why I became interested in super-dimensional physics.」

431:t_1:75.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though I was still a child when the doctor died.」

431:t_1:76.en:
$$トライア$$
「So once I was in a position to get things moving, I looked into her death too.」

431:t_1:78.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you want to try to forget Dr. $$メグミ$$, I won't blame you.」

431:t_1:79.en:
$$トライア$$
「But stop blaming yourself somewhere deep inside, year after year.」

431:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's unusual... I don't often see him treat someone that way.」
